about.text: The custard of the Portuguese custard tart, pastel de nata: milk and eggs infused with sugar, lemon and cinnamon, poured into puff-pastry cases and baked at very high oven heat. Cream may replace the milk, and flour or starch may be added, depending on the recipe.

sources.text: The milk, eggs, sugar, lemon, cinnamon and puff pastry, and the custard method and cream substitution, from this page.
